verdict.rationale: Activepieces flows are explicitly built around triggers (new record, message, form, email) plus actions across 760+ app integrations, positioned as a Zapier alternative with a large app ecosystem for exactly this workflow-trigger use case. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on confirmation of specific trigger types (e.g., new email, form submission) working reliably, and one community report notes rough edges in self-hosted setup.
